record.name: István Kovács
record.title: Associate Professor
record.bio: István Kovács completed his undergraduate and master's studies in Economics and Management at the University of Novi Sad, Faculty of Economics in Subotica, graduating in 2003 and 2006 respectively. He received his PhD from the same institution in 2012, with a dissertation on psychological contract dynamics among software professionals in the Western Balkans. After a period as assistant professor, he was promoted to associate professor in 2018. His research group focuses on employee–organisation relationships in knowledge-intensive firms, examining how perceived contract breach affects turnover intention, affective commitment, and discretionary effort, particularly in flat and agile organisational structures. He teaches Organisational Behaviour and Human Resource Management at undergraduate and master's levels. He routinely uses survey platforms, SPSS, and SmartPLS for structural equation modelling.
open_to: joint research projects on employee retention and HR management in technology companies
contract research: survey design, data collection, and analysis on employee commitment and turnover
consulting on psychological contract management and HR diagnostics for NTP Novi Sad tenant firms
co-supervision of industrial PhD candidates combining management research with company data access
student internships for master's students conducting thesis research in partner companies
record.industry_experience: Kovács has provided consulting to two technology companies in Novi Sad on employee engagement diagnostics and exit interview analysis. He has also delivered training workshops on managing employee expectations during organisational change for HR teams at two mid-sized ICT firms in Vojvodina.
record.notes: Kovács is particularly interested in collaborating with NTP Novi Sad tenants that are willing to share anonymised HR data (turnover records, engagement survey results) for joint research. He is not currently seeking equipment-sharing arrangements. His teaching load is moderate, and he is available for new project commitments from 2025 onward.
